note: Somali voice test (scripts/voice-test.mjs, .github/workflows/tts-voice-test.yml). Real Somali news sentences: politics, names, institutions, regions, numbers and dates, money and percent, abbreviations, Somali-specific spelling (x, c, dh, kh, q, double vowels, the apostrophe), a long paragraph, and whole published articles.

sentences.text: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta magaalada Muqdisho ku qaabilay Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Axmed.
Ra'iisul Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre iyo Madaxweynihii hore Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo ayaa labaduba ka qeybgalay kulanka Villa Soomaaliya.
Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka ayaa ansixiyay sharciga doorashooyinka, kadib dood dheer oo ay yeesheen xildhibaanada.
Ciidamada dowladda ayaa howlgal ka sameeyay gobollada Shabeellaha Dhexe, Hiiraan, Galgaduud iyo Jubbada Hoose, gaar ahaan degmooyinka Ceel Buur iyo Xarardheere.
Shirka ayaa dhacay 28-kii Oktoobar 2026, waxaana ka qeybgalay 450 wufuud oo ka kala yimid 35 waddan.
Miisaaniyadda sanadka 2027 waxay gaartay $1.5 bilyan, taas oo 12% ka badan tii sanadkii hore.
Wakiilka QM-da iyo taliyaha ciidamada AUSSOM ayaa la kulmay saraakiisha IGAD, iyagoo ka wada hadlay amniga gobolka.
Xukuumadda waxay ka digtay in abaarta ba'an ee ka jirta Gedo iyo Bakool ay saameyn xun ku yeelan karto dhaqaalaha, caafimaadka iyo waxbarashada carruurta.

Khilaafka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dhinacyada mucaaradka ayaa galay marxalad cusub, kaddib markii ay soo baxeen warar muujinaya in Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed uusan weli isku raacin qaabka iyo shuruudaha lagu geli karo wada-hadalka uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku baaqay. Xildhibaano ka tirsan labada aqal ayaa sheegay in loo baahan yahay in la helo is-afgarad qaran ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga doorashooyinka.
